items.name: Courtyard Room
items.title: Courtyard Room · Can Arbós, Palma
items.meta: A 20 m² room around the courtyard of Can Arbós, in Palma's old town. One window, sun from late morning, and no street noise.
items.summary: 20 m² onto the courtyard. Cool in summer, and the quietest rooms in the house.
items.text: These rooms are on the first and second floors, around the courtyard. The window looks across at the stone arches, so there's no view of the street and no street noise either. Sun reaches the window from late morning. In August the thick walls keep them cooler than the rooms on the square.
items.light: One window, sun from late morning

items.name: Old Town Room
items.title: Old Town Room · Can Arbós, Palma
items.meta: A 24 m² room on the square at Can Arbós, in Palma's old town, with two tall windows and a balcony for two chairs.
items.summary: 24 m² with two tall windows and a small balcony over the square.
items.text: The Old Town Rooms face the square in front of the house. Two windows run almost floor to ceiling, and one opens onto a balcony wide enough for two chairs. Mornings are bright. The square has no bars, so evenings stay calm, but you'll hear neighbours walking home.

items.name: Junior Suite
items.title: Junior Suite · Can Arbós, Palma
items.meta: A 32 m² corner suite at Can Arbós, in Palma's old town, with windows on two sides, a bath and a sofa bed for a third guest.
items.summary: 32 m² on a corner, with windows on two sides and room for a third guest.
items.text: Each Junior Suite sits on a corner of the house, so light comes in from two directions. There's a sitting area with a sofa that opens into a bed for a third adult. The bathroom has a bath and a separate shower.
items.bed: King, 180 cm, and a sofa bed

items.name: Terrace Suite
items.title: Terrace Suite · Can Arbós, Palma
items.meta: A 38 m² suite on the top floor of Can Arbós, in Palma's old town, with a private 15 m² terrace over the rooftops.
items.summary: 38 m² on the top floor, with your own 15 m² terrace over the rooftops.
items.text: The three Terrace Suites share the top floor with the rooftop pool. Each one has a private terrace with two loungers and a table, looking across the tiled roofs of La Calatrava. Breakfast can be served out there. The rooftop bar stays open until 23:00, and you may hear it from your terrace.
items.light: Top floor, sun most of the day

items.name: The Arbós Suite
items.title: The Arbós Suite · Can Arbós, Palma
items.meta: The largest room at Can Arbós, in Palma's old town, with two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a terrace for four, across 55 m².
items.summary: 55 m² on the top floor, with two bedrooms and a terrace for four.
items.text: The largest room in the house has two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a sitting room between them. One bedroom has a king bed and the other has two singles. The terrace has a dining table for four. It suits two couples travelling together. The rooftop bar stays open until 23:00, and you may hear it from your terrace.
items.bed: One king, 180 cm, and two singles, 90 cm
items.light: Top floor, sun most of the day
